youtube.description:
Uncle ne poocha: "Operation toh surgeon karte hain, aap kya karti hain?" 🤔
Dr Saathi ne kaha: Uncle, surgeon operation karte hain, aur main aapko surakshit rakhti hoon! 💚

Sach kya hai?
✅ Anaesthesia doctor bhi poore qualified doctor hote hain, upar se anaesthesia ki special training
✅ Operation se pehle woh aapki jaanch karke aapke liye anaesthesia ka plan banate hain
✅ Poore operation ke dauraan woh aapke saath rehkar dil aur saans par lagaataar nazar rakhte hain
✅ Operation ke baad dard kam rakhne ka plan bhi woh banate hain
Koi bhi sawaal ho, apne doctor se poochhiye.
